title: How early should you arrive at Shannon Airport?
author: Brogan
intro: For a European flight from Shannon, two hours is plenty and often more than you need. For the US, allow at least three hours, because you clear US immigration before you board. And since September 2026, Shannon lets you carry liquids up to two litres. Here's how to plan it.
seo_title: How early to arrive at Shannon Airport? (2026)
seo_description: About 2 hours for Europe and at least 3 for the US, where you clear US preclearance in Shannon. Liquids up to 2 litres are now allowed at security.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **European flights:** about 2 hours
- **US flights:** at least 3 hours
- **Liquids:** up to 2 litres each
- **Bus from Limerick:** route 343

We checked this advice in November 2026. Your airline's bag drop and gate deadlines are the ones that count, and they're on your booking. Procedures change, so check the airport's and the airline's current advice before you travel.

sections.heading: Why Shannon is usually quick
sections.text:
Shannon is a small, single-terminal airport, and outside the summer peaks it is rarely crowded. The walk from the door to security to the gates is short, so on a quiet midweek morning you can be airside within minutes.

The busy times are the early-morning departures, when several Ryanair flights leave close together, and the summer and Christmas holidays. Ryanair is the biggest airline at Shannon, with a record 30 routes in summer 2026, so its departure waves set the pace.

sections.heading: How early for your flight
sections.text:
| Trip | Flight | Arrive |
| --- | --- | --- |
| City break, hand luggage only | Midweek, mid-morning | **About 90 minutes** before |
| Sun holiday, bags to drop | Early morning | **About 2 hours** before |
| Christmas or summer holidays | Any time | **2 to 2½ hours** before |
| Flight to the US | Any time | **At least 3 hours** before |

These are our suggestions, built from the airline deadlines and how the airport works. Ryanair's bag drop closes 40 minutes before departure, and it doesn't make exceptions.

Tip: check in online as soon as it opens. With hand luggage only and your boarding pass on your phone, you can go straight to security.

sections.heading: Flying to the US: preclearance
sections.text:
Shannon is one of the few airports outside North America with full US preclearance. US Customs and Border Protection officers check your passport, ESTA or visa and bags in Shannon, before you board, and you land in America as a domestic passenger with no immigration queue.

The catch is that it all happens before the flight. Aer Lingus asks passengers flying to the US to arrive at least three hours before departure to allow time for preclearance. The US routes are mostly seasonal: Delta to [New York](/destinations/new-york) and United to [Chicago](/destinations/chicago) returned for summer 2026, and Aer Lingus has flown to [Boston](/destinations/boston) and New York. Check what's flying on your dates.

Watch out: you need an approved ESTA or a US visa before you fly. Preclearance can refuse boarding at Shannon if your paperwork isn't in order.

sections.heading: Security and liquids
sections.text:
Since 7 September 2026, Shannon has allowed liquids in containers of up to two litres in hand luggage, thanks to its newer 3D scanners. You can leave liquids and laptops in your bag at security.

- **Coming home:** the rules at the other airport apply. Many airports still use the 100ml limit, so pack for the stricter one.
- **Airline limits:** your airline's hand luggage size and weight rules still apply.
- **Things change:** Shannon briefly went back to the 100ml rule earlier in 2026, so check the airport's website before you pack.

sections.heading: Getting to Shannon Airport
sections.text:
- **By bus:** Bus Éireann route 343 runs between Limerick and the airport via Bunratty and Shannon town, about every 20 to 30 minutes in the day, with services through the night on most days of the year.
- **By car:** Shannon is about 25 minutes from Limerick and 20 minutes from Ennis, with short and long-stay car parks next to the terminal.
- **By taxi:** there's a rank outside arrivals, and the trip from Limerick usually takes under half an hour.

Bus timetables change, and services are sometimes cancelled, so check Bus Éireann's service updates on the day if you're relying on an early bus.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Shannon?
sections.text:
Shannon's routes have included sun spots like [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote), [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) and [Madeira](/destinations/madeira), city breaks to [Kraków](/destinations/krakow), [Rome](/destinations/rome) and [Madrid](/destinations/madrid), and a Lapland route for Christmas. Routes change each season, so check the airport's destinations page for what's flying on your dates.

For more ideas, browse the [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) and [Christmas holidays](/destinations/christmas-holidays) pages. If your family can't agree, add a few ideas to somewhere.party and let the draw decide.

faqs.question: How early should I get to Shannon Airport for a European flight?
faqs.answer: About two hours is a safe rule, or 90 minutes with hand luggage only on a quiet day. Ryanair's bag drop closes 40 minutes before departure.

faqs.question: How early should I get to Shannon for a flight to the US?
faqs.answer: At least three hours, because you go through US preclearance in Shannon before you board. Aer Lingus gives the same advice.

faqs.question: Can you take liquids over 100ml through Shannon Airport security?
faqs.answer: Yes. Since 7 September 2026, Shannon allows containers of up to two litres in hand luggage. Check the rules at your return airport too.

faqs.question: Is there a bus to Shannon Airport?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bus Éireann route 343 runs between Limerick and Shannon Airport via Bunratty, every 20 to 30 minutes in the day.
